format: Silent captioned walkthrough; images are real computed outputs or attributed public software frames.

chapters.title: Photonics & scientific tools
chapters.zh: 从小型可复现结果开始，认识这组科研与互动工具。
chapters.en: Start with bounded, reproducible results. This tour uses independent synthetic mathematics and public software frames.

chapters.title: Inspect before analysis
chapters.zh: 先识别文件覆盖、重复与冲突，原输入字节保持不变。
chapters.en: Three files, 24 rows, three overlap pairs and two mesh conflicts. SHA-256 checks preserve the original input bytes.

chapters.title: Keep observations & missing slots
chapters.zh: 同一批候选追踪前后对照，缺失位置不会被悄悄补齐。
chapters.en: The same 265 observations appear before and after tracking. Eight missing slots remain missing; labels need physical interpretation.

chapters.title: Render explicit plotting specifications
chapters.zh: 曲线、非方形网格与曲面共享明确的数据及导出约定。
chapters.en: Lines, a non-square grid with a hole, and layered surfaces. Height and color are independent channels; axes and legends remain visible.

chapters.title: One dataset, several useful views
chapters.zh: 同一组合成数组形成能带、Q 与偏振视图。
chapters.en: One synthetic dataset produces band, illustrative Q and signed polarization views. The example checks tracking, orientation and slice maxima.

chapters.title: Check an optical approximation
chapters.zh: 通用高斯光束传播：用解析宽度与功率守恒检查数值。
chapters.en: A generic Gaussian beam example compares propagation against analytic width and conserved power within its stated approximation.

chapters.title: Connect parameters to a real layout
chapters.zh: 独立生成的圆环、焊盘与标记，同时输出 GDS 与预览。
chapters.en: Generic rings, pads and markers generate both GDS and a matching preview. Round-trip checks compare bounds, counts and area.

chapters.title: Explore waves interactively
chapters.zh: 公开程序真实画面：双源干涉，并保留上游作者归属。
chapters.en: A real public-program frame showing two-source interference. EM-Flow retains its Falstad and other upstream attribution.

chapters.title: Try one small, shareable task
chapters.zh: 能否运行？用于什么任务？还缺哪项能力？
chapters.en: Run the combined example in a fresh environment. Share a small input, the output you need, and the capability that is missing.
